'''Starfire flash bang grenades''' were a type of [[Flash grenade/Legends|flash-bang grenades]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They were produced by [[Imperial Arms]] and cost 75 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
